Subject: RE: Request: trial credit application + accounting note for INV-4583

Team —

Reviewed the usage calc. Accounting guidance below:

- Treatment: This is a promotional/marketing credit related to trial usage. Standard practice is to record this as a contra-revenue entry (reduce recognized revenue) and to issue a credit memo that references the original invoice (INV-4583).
- Offset vs credit memo: If Acme wants a netted payment (preferred by them), we can apply a credit memo directly against INV-4583 in our AR system and show a net due. That will generate a credit memo number and an AR offset entry.
- GL mapping: Use GL 4002 (Software Revenue) with contra-revenue posting to GL 4002-CR for the $7,500. Include a memo field: "Promo trial credit — refer INV-4583 / HS-000762".
- Timing & docs: Billing will prepare a draft credit memo. Marissa, please prepare CRD-4583-draft.pdf and confirm the credit memo number. Karthik, we may need to update the HubSpot deal and note the accounting entry for recognition review.
- External note for Acme AP: Provide a one-paragraph description they can attach to their PO/AP entry: "Redwood Inference issued a credit memo to offset unused trial credits. Credit references INV-4583; net due reflects the offset."

If we want to avoid issuing a standalone physical credit memo (for simpler AP flow), we can still post an internal credit memo and automatically apply it to INV-4583 so Acme sees the net due. Same accounting impact. I sign off on this approach.

Lauren Bishop
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
